scope: Reviewed contract and implemented fixed local I/O/end/inspection-loss controls; no production changes or original acceptance
status: Scoped local implementation/validation complete; original cases and gates remain open
limits: Twenty native PostgreSQL cases, two explicit synthetic Unix peers and six pure controls are overlapping scoped execution evidence, not original case/gate acceptance.
Loopback relay is test-only opaque transport, not production admission authority. Native pg/TLS still verifies canonical hostname/CA; partial-connect stalls do not complete TLS or open an upstream.
Read acknowledgement loss is encrypted wire withholding/drop. Late delivery separately withholds application acceptance after actual SQL completion. No replay or cancellation inference.
Native end, registered-identity backend/lock absence, read completion and unknown cleanup are distinct. Later driver events or project removal never clear frozen unknown receipts.
Known cleanup for partial-connect controls is exact local closure with zero upstream opens, not an independently inspected backend-absence claim.
Declared boundaries only; no every-await, external-administrator exclusion, authentication, independent durability, target-fencing, populated-data/history or hosted acceptance claim.
